message.content: {"action":"increase_precision","reason":"The only evaluated LUT design fails the 8-LSB accuracy requirement, so improving numerical quality is the priority. Increasing precision is legal with one unvisited neighbor and should reduce phase quantization error while keeping the LUT architecture and area impact modest compared with switching structure or interpolation."}
